steps.label: tables
statements:
CREATE TABLE Person (
      id               INT64 NOT NULL,
      name             STRING(MAX),
      birthday         TIMESTAMP,
      country          STRING(MAX),
      city             STRING(MAX),
    ) PRIMARY KEY (id)

CREATE TABLE Account (
      id               INT64 NOT NULL,
      create_time      TIMESTAMP,
      is_blocked       BOOL,
      nick_name        STRING(MAX),
    ) PRIMARY KEY (id)

CREATE TABLE PersonOwnAccount (
      id               INT64 NOT NULL,
      account_id       INT64 NOT NULL,
      create_time      TIMESTAMP,
      FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES Account (id)
    ) PRIMARY KEY (id, account_id),
      INTERLEAVE IN PARENT Person ON DELETE CASCADE

CREATE TABLE AccountTransferAccount (
      id               INT64 NOT NULL,
      to_id            INT64 NOT NULL,
      amount           FLOAT64,
      create_time      TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
      order_number     STRING(MAX),
      FOREIGN KEY (to_id) REFERENCES Account (id)
    ) PRIMARY KEY (id, to_id, create_time),
      INTERLEAVE IN PARENT Account ON DELETE CASCADE

steps.label: graph
steps.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROPERTY GRAPH FinGraph
      NODE TABLES (Account, Person)
      EDGE TABLES (
        PersonOwnAccount
          SOURCE KEY (id) REFERENCES Person (id)
          DESTINATION KEY (account_id) REFERENCES Account (id)
          LABEL Owns,
        AccountTransferAccount
          SOURCE KEY (id) REFERENCES Account (id)
          DESTINATION KEY (to_id) REFERENCES Account (id)
          LABEL Transfers
      )

steps.label: sql-id-ASC
steps.sql: SELECT id FROM Person ORDER BY id ASC

steps.label: gql-id-ASC
steps.sql: GRAPH FinGraph MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.id ORDER BY p.id ASC

steps.label: gql-limit-ASC
steps.sql: GRAPH FinGraph MATCH(p:Person) RETURN p.id AS v ORDER BY v ASC LIMIT 2

steps.label: sql-id-DESC
steps.sql: SELECT id FROM Person ORDER BY id DESC

steps.label: gql-id-DESC
steps.sql: GRAPH FinGraph MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.id ORDER BY p.id DESC

steps.label: gql-limit-DESC
steps.sql: GRAPH FinGraph MATCH(p:Person) RETURN p.id AS v ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 2

steps.label: gql-id-alias
steps.sql: GRAPH FinGraph MATCH(p:Person) RETURN p.id AS id ORDER BY id

steps.label: gql-name
steps.sql: GRAPH FinGraph MATCH(p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name

steps.label: gql-for-five
steps.sql: GRAPH FinGraph FOR x IN [5,3,1,4,2] RETURN x AS v ORDER BY v LIMIT 5

steps.label: sql-outer-graph
steps.sql: SELECT id FROM GRAPH_TABLE(FinGraph MATCH(p:Person) RETURN p.id AS id ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id
